office_does: A Grant County District Court judge hears misdemeanor and gross-misdemeanor criminal cases and traffic infractions, sets bail and holds preliminary hearings; all three judges are elected countywide to four-year terms.
race_blurb: Uncontested: incumbent Judge Brian D. Gwinn, on the bench since 2021, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Grant County District Court judge since 2021, previously a public defender for 21 years including District Court supervisor at the county Department of Public Defense; the only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: District Court judge since 2021; Superior Court pro tem judge since 2024 [S1]
Public defense in Grant, Okanogan and Spokane counties 2000-2021 [S1]
Developed a therapeutic court for people with substance-use and mental-health disorders [S1]
